title: Your friend sends a “vote for me” link
scenario: A friend’s Instagram account asks you to vote for them in a contest. The link opens a login page and they message, “Please hurry—voting closes soon.” The conversation style sounds like them.

answers.A: Contact your friend through another channel and do not enter credentials into the contest link.
answers.B: Open the contest site independently and see whether your friend is actually listed.
answers.C: Log in if your password manager recognizes the page and autofills your credentials.

explanation: Compromised accounts inherit the victim’s real history and tone. Cross-channel verification checks whether your friend still controls the account.
proTip: A familiar account can be an unfamiliar operator.
